data.name: ContentPathMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: A content path must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty string is passed to ContentPath.

data.name: ContentPathMustBeRelative
data.value: The content path '{0}' must be relative to the site root, but it is rooted.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an absolute path is passed to ContentPath.

data.name: ContentPathMustNotEscapeRoot
data.value: The content path '{0}' escapes the site root.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when a path traverses above the site root with '..' segments.

data.name: OutputPathMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: An output path must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty string is passed to OutputPath.

data.name: OutputPathMustBeRelative
data.value: The output path '{0}' must be relative to the output root, but it is rooted.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an absolute path is passed to OutputPath.

data.name: OutputPathMustNotEscapeRoot
data.value: The output path '{0}' escapes the output root.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when a path traverses above the output root with '..' segments.

data.name: ContentFormatMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: A content format name must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty string is passed to ContentFormat.

data.name: MetadataKeyMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: A metadata key must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty or whitespace-only string is passed to MetadataKey.Create.

data.name: ScopeNameMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: A scope name must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty string is passed to ScopeName.

data.name: FragmentIdMustNotBeEmpty
data.value: A fragment identifier must not be empty.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when an empty string is passed to FragmentId.

data.name: SectionLevelOutOfRange
data.value: The section level must be between {0} and {1}, but it was {2}.
data.comment: ArgumentOutOfRangeException thrown when SectionNode is constructed with a heading level outside the supported range.

data.name: MetadataValueKindMismatch
data.comment: InvalidOperationException thrown when a metadata value is accessed as the wrong kind. {0} is the expected kind, {1} is the actual kind.
